license_note: Layered instruments: each one plays several of the recorded instruments (VSCO 2 CE / VCSL, CC0) at once. No extra samples.

instruments.name: Epic Strings
instruments.description: Violins, violas, cellos and basses together, a big section like a film score. Starts as an orchestra (~20 players).

instruments.name: Soaring Strings
instruments.description: High violins in two octaves with a solo violin on top: the rising theme sound. Starts as a full orchestra (~30 players).

instruments.name: Dark Strings
instruments.description: Low cellos and basses with violas: the brooding, driving string sound of a dark hero film (Batman Begins style).

instruments.name: Braam Brass
instruments.description: Horns, trombones and tuba stacked on one low note: the huge brass blast of a modern trailer. Starts as an orchestra.

instruments.name: Heroic Horns
instruments.description: French horns with trumpets and trombones: a bold, noble hero theme.

instruments.name: Cinematic Piano
instruments.description: A grand piano with a soft string bed under it: emotional, spacious piano scoring.

instruments.name: Trailer Hit
instruments.description: Taiko, bass drum, cymbal and gong in one huge hit.

instruments.name: Kung Fu Flute
instruments.description: A bamboo dizi with a concert flute: the airy, heroic Chinese flute of an animated martial arts film.

instruments.name: Kung Fu Strings
instruments.description: Erhu on top of a string section: sweeping, emotional Chinese-flavoured strings. Starts as a section (~10 players).

instruments.name: Kung Fu Zither
instruments.description: Dan tranh and guzheng plucks with a harp sparkle on top: the shimmering Chinese strings of a temple scene.
